lox.d: a bluish translucent magnetic liquid obtained by compressing gaseous oxygen and then cooling it below its boiling point; used as an oxidizer in rocket propellants

loxapine.d: a tranquilizer (trade name Loxitane) used to treat schizophrenia

loxomataceae.d: very small family of New Zealand ferns

loxodrome.d: a line on a sphere that cuts all meridians at the same angle; the path taken by a ship or plane that maintains a constant compass direction
